result.title: Capitulo 7.1 - Interface and interaction in parametric prosthetic customization
result.summary: The most relevant literature for web-based parametric prosthetic customization platforms includes Peixoto et al. (2025) as the only web-based implementation addressing interface design and user experience, Colombo et al. (2015) for 3D preview and anthropometric input integration, Abbas Alili et al. (2023) for hierarchical human-in-the-loop configuration with AI-assisted parameter tuning, and Quintero et al. (2018) and Bai et al. (2024) for clinician oversight mechanisms, though no single study addresses all features in a web-based parametric context.
